segments.name: Martial arts training programs
segments.description: Provides and administers mixed martial arts training programs, gym programs and related SaaS platforms for gyms, coaches and fans.
segments.evidence: The Company has identified one operating segment as the provision and administration of mixed martial arts training programs, gym programs.

revenueModel.text: Licensee gyms pay usage-based license fees for the Warrior Training Program IP, and academies pay subscription and transaction SaaS fees through BJJLink.
revenueModel.evidence: Based on the license agreement, a usage-based royalty arrangement is in place between the Company and the gyms.

changes.text: In December 2024, the Company acquired BJJLink, a Jiu Jitsu gym management and fintech platform, adding SaaS revenue streams.
changes.evidence: In December 2024, the Company acquired BJJLink, a Jiu Jitsu gym management and fintech platform, for up to US$13 million payable in cash or shares.
